info.title: AAMP Player JSON-RPC API
info.description:
WebSocket-based JSON-RPC 2.0 API for controlling an AAMP media player instance.

Endpoint: ws://<host>:10101

Session lifecycle: openSession -> configureSession (optional) -> playback methods -> closeSession

type.description: Subtitle format (e.g. CLOSED_CAPTIONS, SUBTITLES, WEBVTT, TTML)

methods.name: org.rdk.player.openSession
methods.description: Allocates a player instance and associates it with the calling WebSocket connection. Must be called before any playback or configuration method. Returns a sessionId that is echoed back in all subsequent responses for correlation.

params.name: displayId
params.description: Display/window identifier to associate with this player instance.

sessionId.description: Session identifier to use in subsequent calls

methods.name: org.rdk.player.configureSession
methods.summary: Apply configuration to an open session
methods.description: Applies AAMP configuration key-value pairs to the session. Must be called after openSession and before tune.

params.name: config
params.description: AAMP configuration block as a JSON object or JSON-encoded string.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.closeSession
methods.summary: Close and release a player session
methods.description: Stops any active playback, releases decoder and DRM resources, and destroys the session. After this call the sessionId is invalid. The WebSocket connection itself is not closed.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.play
methods.summary: Start playback of a media stream
methods.description: Instructs the AAMP player to tune to the given URL. Optionally auto-starts playback and accepts a content type hint and trace UUID for diagnostics.

params.name: url
params.description: Media manifest URL (HLS, DASH, progressive MP4, etc.)

params.name: traceUUID
params.description: Correlation UUID forwarded to AAMP diagnostics and telemetry.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.stop
methods.description: Stops the current playback and releases decoder resources. The player returns to the idle state.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.seek
methods.description: Seeks to an absolute position in the stream (in seconds from the start). For live streams, position is relative to the live edge.

params.name: keepPaused
params.description: If true, the player remains paused after seeking.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.seekToLive
methods.description: Moves playback to the current live edge of a live or time-shifted stream.

params.name: keepPaused
params.description: If true, the player remains paused after seeking to live.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for trick-play. Rate 1=normal, 0=pause, 2=2x fast-forward, -2=2x rewind.

params.name: overshootCorrection
params.description: Overshoot correction offset in milliseconds applied during trick play.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setPlaybackSpeed
methods.description: Sets the playback speed directly (equivalent to setRate without the overshoot correction option).

methods.name: org.rdk.player.pauseAt
methods.summary: Schedule a pause at a future position
methods.description: Requests the player to automatically pause when playback reaches the specified position. Pass a negative value to cancel a previously scheduled pause.

params.name: position
params.description: Position in seconds at which to pause. Pass a negative value to cancel.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setRateAndSeek
methods.description: Combines a rate change and a seek into a single atomic operation, avoiding the visual glitch that can occur when calling them separately.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.getState
methods.description: Returns the current lifecycle state of the AAMP player instance.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.getPlaybackDuration
methods.description: Returns -1 for live streams without a known duration.

duration.description: Total stream duration in seconds; -1 for unbounded live streams

rate.description: Current playback rate multiplier (1.0 = normal, 0 = paused)

isLive.description: true if the current stream is a live broadcast

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setVideoMute
methods.summary: Mute or unmute the video plane
methods.description: Blanks (mutes) or restores the video plane without affecting audio.

params.name: muted
params.description: true to blank the video plane; false to restore it.

muted.description: true if the video plane is currently muted (blanked)

language.description: ISO 639 language code of the active audio track (e.g. en)

methods.name: org.rdk.player.getAvailableAudioTracks
methods.description: Returns all audio tracks present in the current manifest.

params.name: allTracks
params.description: true to include tracks from all DASH periods, not just the current one.

tracks.description: Array of available audio track descriptors

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setAudioTrack
methods.summary: Select an audio track by index
methods.description: Switches to the audio track at the specified index from getAvailableAudioTracks.

params.name: trackId
params.description: Zero-based index of the target audio track (>= 0).

methods.name: org.rdk.player.getAudioTrack
methods.summary: Get index of active audio track

trackId.description: Zero-based index of the currently active audio track

methods.name: org.rdk.player.getAudioTrackInfo
methods.summary: Get details of active audio track

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setSubtitleMute
methods.description: Enables or suppresses subtitle rendering without changing the active text track selection.

params.name: muted
params.description: true to hide subtitles; false to show them.

params.name: allTracks
params.description: true to include tracks from all DASH periods.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setTextTrack
methods.summary: Select a text track by index

params.name: trackId
params.description: Zero-based index of the target text track (>= 0).

methods.name: org.rdk.player.getTextTrack
methods.summary: Get index of active text track

trackId.description: Zero-based index of the currently active text track

bitrate.description: Current video bitrate in bits per second

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setVideoBitrate
methods.description: Pins ABR to the profile closest to the specified bitrate. Pass 0 to re-enable automatic ABR.

params.name: bitrate
params.description: Target bitrate in bps; 0 restores automatic ABR.

bitrates.description: Available video bitrates in bps, ascending order

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setInitialBitrate
methods.description: Hints to AAMP which bitrate profile to select at the start of the next tune. ABR may switch away after the initial segments are downloaded.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setMinimumBitrate
methods.summary: Set the ABR minimum bitrate floor
methods.description: Prevents AAMP from selecting any video profile below this bitrate during adaptive bitrate switching.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.getMinimumBitrate
methods.summary: Get the ABR minimum bitrate floor

bitrate.description: Configured minimum ABR bitrate in bps

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setMaximumBitrate
methods.summary: Set the ABR maximum bitrate ceiling
methods.description: Prevents AAMP from selecting any video profile above this bitrate during adaptive bitrate switching.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.getMaximumBitrate
methods.summary: Get the ABR maximum bitrate ceiling

bitrate.description: Configured maximum ABR bitrate in bps

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setLicenseServerURL
methods.summary: Set the DRM license server URL
methods.description: Overrides the license server URL for the active DRM system. Can be used to redirect license requests to a proxy.

drm.description: Name of the active DRM system

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setPreferredDRM
methods.description: Tells AAMP which DRM system to prefer when multiple are available in the manifest.

config.description: Complete current AAMP configuration as a JSON object

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setAppName
methods.description: Sets a human-readable application name included in AAMP diagnostic logs and telemetry.

methods.name: org.rdk.player.setPreferredLanguages
methods.description: Configures fine-grained language selection. All parameters are optional; omit to leave that dimension unchanged.

params.name: languageList
params.description: Comma-separated ISO 639 language codes in priority order (e.g. en,fra,spa).

params.name: labelList
params.description: Comma-separated preferred HLS GROUP-ID or DASH label values.

languageList.description: Comma-separated ISO 639 language codes in preference order

methods.name: org.rdk.player.register
methods.description: After registering, the server pushes matching events as JSON-RPC notifications (no id field)

params.name: event
params.description: Event name (e.g. onProgress) or * for all events.

listeners.description: Active event listener registrations for this session

methods.name: onCCHandleReceived
methods.description: Fired when AAMP provides a handle to the CC decoder after the first decoded video frame.

schema.description: Opaque CC decoder handle

methods.name: onTimedMetadata
methods.summary: Timed metadata cue encountered in the stream
methods.description: Emitted for each HLS #EXT-X-DATERANGE, ID3 frame, or DASH Event block encountered during playback.

methods.description: Delivers a batch of timed-metadata cues as a single JSON-encoded string.

methods.name: onSpeedsChanged
methods.description: Emitted when the set of trick-play speeds supported by the current stream changes.
